title: 감정
sp: K-Pop and J-Pop fusion with high-energy bubblegum pop elements. Key of G Major. sub-bass follows piano root notes. oboe melody over piano ostinato. The arrangement includes a subtle electric piano playing jazz-influenced extensions. The upright bass follows a standard two-beat bossa pattern, emphasizing the root and fifth. K-Pop ballad featuring male vocals, acoustic guitar, and violin. The arrangement uses sudden stops and dramatic builds. The female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate head voice with minimal vibrato.

title: 기타
sp: Folk-pop instrumental featuring a lead violin and acoustic guitar. Key of E Major, 82 BPM. fingerstyle acoustic guitar. slap bass enters, rhythmic male vocals. A melodic glockenspiel motif enters every eight bars, playing a descending pentatonic scale. distorted reese bass enters, breakbeat drums. The production is clean with light reverb on the vocals and a crisp, forward-leaning acoustic guitar mix. A single steel-string acoustic guitar performs a fingerstyle arrangement with steady thumb-plucked bass notes on the downbeats and syncopated melodic fills. The production is intimate and dry, emphasizing the natural timbre of the nylon strings and the singer's breathy articulation.
